pages.text: Grandpa Badger made soup. He gave Nono a little covered container.
Nono wanted to eat it warm at home. He had to cross the whole alley.
It was too heavy to fly with. He waddled along.
Cat paw prints crossed the middle of the alley. Nono set the container in the snow.
He followed the prints one by one. The container stayed behind.
When he returned and opened the lid, there was no steam.
The soup was cold. Nono trudged back to the shop.
Grandpa gave him a steaming container and pointed to Nono's feet.
Nono gripped the handle with both hands and walked home without putting it down.
At home, steam still rose from the soup. He blew on it and ate.
